$comment: Single list of every shared capability the template cannot yet consume by exact published version. Each entry is gated: `check` fails when a placeholder's package is listed in rightkit-versions.json at all (published or staged), and when its stand-in file is gone. When a package is listed: pin it exactly, delete the stand-in, delete the entry. Nothing else in the template is a local copy of shared code.

rightkit-qa.blockedOn: distribution of the `rightkit-qa` binary to app checkouts (crate is publish=false; apps invoke the managed binary)
rightkit-qa.standIn: none (rightkit-qa.toml + tests/scenarios are the real configuration)

scripts.scripts/package-placeholder.mjs: Windows NSIS packaging (rightkit:package:win) and the mac development install script are Node release tooling (right-release): copy GenRight scripts/{win-nsis,install-macos-development}.mjs; fails loudly until then. mac signing/notarization is scripts/build-mac-notarized.sh (real)
scripts.src-tauri/tauri.conf.json plugins.update: endpoint + pubkey are placeholders; use the suite updater pubkey and the app's R2/GitHub endpoint
